text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My Make Debut is finally here! My 
movements are as uncoordinated as ever, 
but all that's left is to charge straight 
for the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What do you mean by saying we aren't 
aiming for a GⅠ right now, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So getting used to racing is the 
top priority for growth, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Understood! To become an ideal 
princess, I shall start by accomplishing 
the little things!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're the one aiming to become a 
legendary Trainer! Let's keep joining 
forces and blow them all away! Woooah~! 
Princess☆Lariat~~!
